text_block_list.name: Jun
text_block_list.text:
...What's this? I hear a commotion within the palace.
Could it be an enemy assault?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだ、
王宮内が騒がしいな。
まさか王宮内に敵が？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? And it looks like they're no ordinary enemies.
Hahah! We may have quite the situation on our hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーむ、
しかも相手は、
ただの敵じゃないな。
ははっ！
　これはかなりの異常事態のようだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Jun
text_block_list.text: What in the world is going on?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 一体何が起きているんだ……！？
